description: Open a Google Search Console page (overview, performance, inspect, pages, sitemaps, removals, links, security, settings, etc.). Always call before any gsc_* tool to land on the right report. Pages: overview, insights, performance_search, performance_discover, performance_news, inspect, pages, videos, sitemaps, removals, cwv_mobile, cwv_desktop, https, security, manual_actions, enhancements_breadcrumbs, enhancements_faq, enhancements_sitelinks, enhancements_videos, enhancements_products, enhancements_recipes, enhancements_review, enhancements_events, enhancements_jobposting, enhancements_speakable, enhancements_qa, enhancements_logos, enhancements_sitenames, enhancements_dataset, enhancements_practice, enhancements_math, enhancements_video_indexing, links, achievements, settings, crawl_stats, users, change_address, associations, disavow, shopping, merchant.

page.description: GSC section to open. Property is preserved from current resource_id unless `property` is set.

property.description: Property to load (e.g. "sc-domain:example.com" or "https://example.com/"). Defaults to active property.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. Auto-resolved or auto-created.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab. Auto-resolved if omitted.

name: gsc_navigate
